title: Ephemeral prompt sampling and anchored retention for query telemetry and metrics
creator: Ava Morgan
description: Background: Customers need fine-grained controls that reduce storage/cost exposure while preserving legally and operationally necessary evidence. Current per-route TTLs are all-or-nothing and force customers to either keep full request payloads for long periods or purge everything and lose forensic capability. This ticket proposes an approach that combines ephemeral sampling of raw prompts/responses with anchored retention (store lightweight anchors and sampled full artifacts) to provide auditable evidence and lower retention cost for high-volume routes.
goals: Allow admins to mark routes as 'ephemeral-sampled' with sampling rate and anchor retention period
Persist an immutable anchor record for every request (metadata + hash) for a short anchored TTL
Persist full prompt/response artifacts only for a sampled subset according to per-route sampling policy
Provide an automated evidence export job that can reconstruct a request chain using anchors + sampled artifacts for compliance audits
Expose clear cost/volume estimates in Console for different sampling/anchor TTL combinations
non_goals: Handling legal holds that require immediate retention of every artifact (these will be handled by separate legal-hold flow)
Changing encryption-at-rest or KMS integrations (out of scope for this ticket)
requirements: API: route config must accept fields 'sampling_rate' (0.0-1.0), 'anchor_ttl_days', and 'sample_ttl_days'
Runtime: Anchor creation must be sub-ms additional latency and stored as small record (route, tenant, timestamp, hash, minimal metadata)
Console: New route UI to preview estimated monthly storage & cost given historic QPS and chosen sampling/TTL
Evidence export: A job that accepts a time window, tenant, and optional route filter and produces a signed bundle containing anchors and sampled artifacts needed to reconstruct requests
Auditability: All retention configuration changes must be recorded with actor, timestamp, and a diff in the audit log
Compatibility: Must integrate with existing retention engine and not break per-route TTL overrides or legal-hold flows
Security: Anchor records must be tamper-evident (include hash) and accessible to authorized export jobs only
proposed_solution: Data model: Introduce 'anchor' record stored in retention subsystem: {anchor_id, tenant_id, route_id, timestamp, artifact_hash, minimal_meta} (implementation detail not nested here)

Sampling: At request completion runtime will call retention service with (anchor, sample_decision). If sample_decision==true, store full artifact with sample_ttl_days, else store anchor with anchor_ttl_days
Export: Evidence export job gathers anchors in window, fetches sampled artifacts referenced by anchors where available, and creates a signed bundle with manifest linking anchors -> artifacts
Console: Add Route Retention panel with slider controls for sampling_rate and anchor/sample TTLs and a cost-preview table computed from recent route telemetry
API: Extend route API (PATCH /routes/{id}) to accept sampling_rate and two TTL fields; expose GET /retention/estimate?route_id to return estimated monthly bytes and cost
Safeguards: Disallow sampling_rate > 0.5 for routes marked 'high-risk' unless admin override with audit justification
ui_changes: Route settings modal: new 'Ephemeral sampling' toggle with inputs for sampling rate (percent), anchor TTL (days), sample TTL (days)
Cost preview: inline estimate card that shows projected monthly storage and per-100k request counts stored (anchors vs samples)
Evidence export UI: New 'Export evidence' action for tenant admins to run ad-hoc exports or schedule recurring exports; includes signed bundle download link
Audit trail: On each route settings page show the last 6 retention config changes with actor and timestamp
api_changes: PATCH /routes/{id}: support body fields sampling_rate, anchor_ttl_days, sample_ttl_days, sampling_mode (random/stratified)
POST /evidence-exports: create export job, returns job_id; jobs produce signed bundle stored in export storage configured per-tenant
acceptance_criteria: Console: Admin can configure sampling_rate and TTLs and see consistent cost preview matching runtime metrics within 10%
Runtime: Anchor write adds <1ms median tail to request path when enabled and does not abort on transient errors (graceful degradation)
Sampling correctness: Over a 24h test without config changes, observed sampled fraction is within ±2% of configured sampling_rate for random mode

Exports: Evidence export job for a 7-day window returns a manifest that, when combined with sampled artifacts, allows reconstruction of at least 95% of anchors with sampled artifacts present (expected given sampling_rate)
Audit: All retention config changes are present in the audit logs with actor and diff
Security: Signed bundles validate and anchor hashes match artifact content for sampled artifacts in export
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta private tenants): Implement API + runtime anchors + simple console controls, enable for selected low-risk tenants
Phase 2 (Public Opt-in): Add export jobs, cost preview, expand to more tenants with feature flag
Phase 3 (GA): Enforce admin override policy, integrate with legal-hold workflow (disallow purge during hold), and document in public docs
Monitoring: Add metrics for anchors_written, samples_written, export_job_success_rate, and monthly storage estimate discrepancy
test_plan: Unit tests for sampling decision logic, anchor record creation, and TTL propagation
Integration tests: end-to-end with retention service mock to validate anchors vs samples stored and export bundle creation
Load test: simulate 10k RPS on a route with ephemeral sampling enabled to verify latency impact <1ms median and 99.9% success of anchor writes
Security tests: validate signed bundle verification and unauthorized access attempts to export bundles are rejected
Compliance tests: run a simulated audit where export bundle is consumed and auditors can reconstruct request chains
